summary: MDJM LTD filed a routine Form 6-K for the fiscal period ended 30 June 2026, a US-equivalent foreign private issuer current report; the exhibit set is dominated by standard XBRL tagging rather than a transactional announcement. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, ownership split, or regulatory clock is disclosed. Tagged items reference share-based compensation to officers and directors and warrant inputs, not a special situation. This is an ordinary periodic filing with no event to trade; watch for future 6-K disclosures only.
